comparison_definition: Unweighted eligible-tract median and IQR; n < 5 individual observations only; fixed eligible-city median reference
moe_method: Approximate ACS 90% MOE; root-sum-of-squares components, subset proportion with ratio fallback
limitations: Descriptive ecological comparisons, not causes or individual risk
ACS and SVI windows differ and overlap; these are not longitudinal social measures
SVI and ACS indicators overlap; not independent corroboration
Small groups and ACS uncertainty limit interpretation
SVI was developed for disaster vulnerability, not a firearm-violence priority score
Unavailable burden tracts excluded from comparisons, retained in geometry
National SVI ranks intentionally answer a national-reference question, not within-state standing
Pooled ACS percentages and population-weighted mean SVI ranks answer different questions from unweighted tract medians
Mean SVI ranks are relative neighborhood-context summaries, not official group ranks or individual vulnerability
Pooled ACS MOEs approximate covariance; fixed population weights and differing source vintages add uncertainty

population_comparison_definition.acs: 100 * sum(numerator) / sum(denominator); population for age/race, each indicator's own universe otherwise
population_comparison_definition.svi: sum(national tract rank * positive fixed ACS 2020–2024 population) / sum(positive fixed population); descriptive mean rank, not an official aggregated SVI percentile
population_comparison_definition.missingness: Measure-specific complete numerator/denominator pairs or observed SVI with positive population; covered population and valid tract counts retained
population_comparison_definition.uncertainty: Approximate pooled ACS 90% MOE via root-sum-of-squares and subset-proportion/ratio fallback; no SVI MOE or tests of between-group differences
population_comparison_definition.small_groups: Point estimate retained with fewer-than-five warning; a one-tract group is a single observation
population_comparison_definition.filter_behavior: Full category summaries remain fixed when the browser searches or filters; active category is highlighted only
